statement_summary: Qualified Individual designated in writing
Executive charter for PCI DSS; responsibility per requirement
Annual risk assessment and targeted risk analyses
PCI DSS scope confirmed every six months and after significant change
Quarterly reviews that staff perform security tasks
Service provider due diligence, agreements, AOCs, responsibility matrices, annual review
AOC and responsibility matrix provided to merchants on request
Annual written Qualified Individual report to the CEO and COO
Workforce MFA; phishing-resistant for administrators and CDE access
MFA for high-risk merchant portal roles; risk analysis for the rest
All access including tokens removed on the last day
Six-month access reviews; quarterly reconciliation to HR
Service accounts scoped to one workload; no standing administrator roles
Repository tokens tied to single sign-on and expire within 30 days
Step-up MFA and call-back for funding account changes
Written plan covering 314.4(h) areas and PCI DSS 12.10.1 elements
Security alerts monitored and answered 24x7
Card data compromise: preserve evidence; sponsor bank immediately; Visa within 3 calendar days
12 CFR 53.4 four-hour determination and notice to bank-designated contacts
FTC notice within 30 days for 500 or more consumers
Procedure for PAN found outside the CDE
Annual plan test
PAN stored only in the token vault, encrypted with HSM keys
Quarterly deletion beyond retention; two-year disposal rule
Monthly and quarterly PAN discovery
Token-only, minimized extracts with use limits and deletion certificates
Documented key management with dual control and custodian acknowledgments
Encrypted second-region backups restore-tested quarterly
Never paste card numbers into email, chat, tickets, or AI tools
Annual training with phishing and social engineering; quarterly phishing exercises
Approved generative AI tools only; no Restricted or Confidential data in public chatbots
